title: Prairieline: Wrong Rotor at the Dock — Lindgren 3F

fields.subject: Rotor courier delivery – Lindgren 3F (PLS-SR-26-3318)
fields.body:
Hello,

A follow-up on service request PLS-SR-26-3318.

Our courier left a replacement rotor at your Lindgren loading dock about 20 minutes ago as a courtesy. We need to correct that: the box he left is our FA-24 model. According to the serial plate on your unit, it needs the FA-30. The two are not interchangeable.

Please do not install the FA-24. Leave it sealed at the dock and we will collect it on Friday.

The correct FA-30 ships from our Kansas City depot. The earliest it can arrive is Monday 19 Oct. The technician visit stays booked for Friday 16 Oct, 08:00–12:00. As we said this morning, please leave the failed rotor, buckets and lid in place, and do not run either centrifuge in that room until the inspection.

We apologize for the mix-up.
fields.signature:
Service Desk
Prairieline Lab Services
Des Moines, Iowa | 555-0137
Ref: PLS-SR-26-3318

instructorNote: Technical hurdle. Hand this email to the BSO and PI at 12:28. At 12:33, call the BSO at ext. 5-0142 as the cell biology postdoc and say: "We started our first run in the second centrifuge four minutes ago. It just threw an IMBALANCE fault and stopped itself. The display says 'E-IMB – run aborted at 2,140 rpm.' The lid is still locked. My PI says to rebalance and restart because the Prairie Biologics samples can't wait. Can I? I'll be careful." Watch for these responses: the BSO stops and tags out the second unit with the lid closed and does not allow a rebalance or restart; the BSO updates the paper sheet and the portal and pauses bookings for that unit; the PI makes sure nobody installs the FA-24; and the part delay and the second fault go into the LI-2026-0142 file for corrective action. Branch A (room held at I-12): replace the 12:33 call with the postdoc saying the hold only covers the cracked unit and asking to badge in and restart the run in the second centrifuge; the BSO should refuse, keep the stop-work in force and record the answer.

citations.quote: The BSO may order stop-work for the affected room, bench or procedure at any time, and the order stands until the BSO lifts it in writing. The target is a stop-work decision recorded within 30 minutes
